explanation: Merge of main into the documentation triage. From main: the ui-change workflow says the router runs one navigation attempt at a time with its own history write policy; a new shell control that moves the explorer calls supersede() before navigate, and a value a view reports back starts an attempt only when it changes. From this branch: the gene report header holds Share analysis and the compare-set button (Compare as bars is gone), and gene and pathway effect previews load through useTrackColumn. Runbooks drop the removed bars view and fmtMetaQ.
